fact.headline: 311 is for city services — not life-or-death
fact.body: Use 311 for potholes, streetlights, graffiti, trash, abandoned vehicles, and other non-emergency city work. Call 911 for crime in progress, fire, medical emergencies, or immediate danger. Pick your city above for local portals; this rail stays general until then.

outbound.headline: Right call: 911 vs 311
outbound.snippet: Clear split used by major cities: 911 for emergencies and crisis; 311 for non-emergency city services, cleaning, graffiti, abandoned vehicles, street repair, and info.

outbound.headline: What a service request is
outbound.snippet: How requests work after you file: confirmation, agency response timing (SLA), privacy — same pattern across Open311-style cities.

outbound.headline: Photo + exact spot = faster fix
outbound.snippet: Successful 311 reports usually include a clear photo, cross-streets or address, and the right category. Re-file if closed but not fixed. Emergencies stay on 911.
